title: Challenges catalog
description: Challenges shown in the map's Challenges panel: what the player must do, how many times, and the reward.
x-help:
A challenge is a goal such as 'kill 25 Scorched'. The map's Challenges panel groups them by category and shows progress. Lifetime challenges are permanent, daily ones re-roll every day at UTC midnight and weekly ones every Monday.

A challenge's kind says what counts as progress (kills, items gained, crafting, quests and so on) and its conditions narrow that down, for example to a certain enemy. Conditions are written as groups: every group must hold, and a group holds when any one of its conditions does. A challenge can be a sub-challenge of a parent, or require other challenges to be finished first.

Tales sets caps and XP rewards itself from the challenge's count and frequency, so the numbers written in a catalog are not used. Perk card packs are taken from the catalog. Progress is saved by the challenge number, which is the object ID of its form.

settings.description: Feature-wide values; a later plugin's field replaces the earlier one.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the catalog was converted from. Informational.

output_plugin.title: Output plugin
output_plugin.description: The plugin that holds the challenge records.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Groups in the panel's category rail, in order.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.description: The challenges, in panel order. Progress is saved by the form's object ID, so do not reuse one for a different goal.

id.title: Challenge (CHAL)
id.description: The challenge record. Its object ID is the challenge number progress is saved under.

category.title: Category
category.description: Which category the challenge is listed under.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: Lifetime: counts forever. Daily: up to five roll each day. Weekly: up to seven roll each week.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What counts as progress: kill, acquire, craft, craft_or_scrap, workshop, harvest, discover, consume, quest, level, lock, hack, claim, parent or script.

count.title: Times required
count.description: How many times it must happen. Tales scales the caps and XP reward from this.

parent.title: Parent challenge
parent.description: Makes this a step of a bigger challenge; the parent completes when its steps do. Daily and weekly rolls skip steps.

prerequisites.title: Must finish first
prerequisites.description: Challenges that have to be completed before this one is active.

sub_challenges.title: Steps
sub_challenges.description: The challenges that make up this one.

reward.title: Reward
reward.description: Caps and XP are set by Tales; only perk card packs are read from here.

caps.title: Caps
caps.description: Ignored: Tales sets caps from the challenge's count and frequency.

xp.title: XP
xp.description: Ignored: Tales sets XP from the challenge's count and frequency.

perkCardPacks.title: Perk card packs
perkCardPacks.description: Perk card packs paid when the challenge completes.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Every group must hold; a group holds when any one condition in it does.

fn.title: Check
fn.description: Name of the check, for example one that tests the killed actor's keywords. Use 'group' to nest a group.

on.title: Applies to
on.description: Which actor the check looks at, such as the target.

value.title: Value
value.description: The number the check is compared with.
